trap-superlative.notes: STRUCTURAL FINDING (not a trap, do not fix inline). Row 'Markov parameter z = q^3/(q^2+1) (convention D; z(q_0)=0.61268803714646525160)' sits in the bar-SYMMETRIC table but convention-D z is NOT bar-invariant: at the 50-dps proton q_0, z_D(q)=0.6126880371464652515958 while z_D(1/q)=0.4036277383508259361650, ratio exactly q^{-4}. Convention-C z=sqrt(q)/(q+1)=1/(q^{1/2}+q^{-1/2}) IS bar-invariant (0.4993203341836944524134 at both q and 1/q, 40 dps) - i.e. this row's membership is true for C and false for D. The quoted NUMBER is correct: z_D at Q_50_DIGIT_STR = 1.1099785827513808075916690956107688798744991218736 (proton pin) is 0.612688037146465251595829863946, rounding to the printed 20 digits exactly; it is NOT the float64 value (0.61268803714646524749...) nor the 16-digit-q value (...2436...). Proposed: move the row to bar-involution-table3-data (anti/non-symmetric) or annotate it 'bar-symmetric under convention C only; z_D obeys bar(z_D) = q^{-4} z_D'. Other rows verified bar-even: [2]_q, [n]_q, b^2 = 1 - 1/[2]_q^2 (= (q^4+q^2+1)/(q^2+1)^2 = 0.75270211325196540159 at q and at 1/q, and = 3/4 at q=1, matching the Hoefsmit b of rem:F3-eps6-leading-eq-neg-2b-cubed), sigma_avg = sigma - h/2 (from sigma - sigma^{-1} = h), cosh(h) (h bar-odd), Li_2^q as the symmetrised log-Phi_q.
